name: @avidia/ai-router
description: Centralized, provider-independent, task-aware + complexity-aware AI model router (v1). Every AI gateway resolves its model through routeAiTask() instead of a hard-coded model name, so model selection lives in one place: task -> tier -> concrete model, with bounded retry, safe fallback, and privacy-safe observability. Server-side only — never in the client bundle.
